_comment: Differences from the legacy site that were approved on purpose. scripts/parity-check.mjs ignores a text, link or font diff line that matches an entry exactly. A selector listed under hide is blanked on both pages before they are compared (parts that are random on every visit: the related posts tiles). A page listed under pixels may differ by that percentage of pixels. Every entry needs a reason; anything not listed here fails the check.

/projects/rehabilitation.reason: Legacy shuffles each rehabilitation project's photos on every visit, so the slide showing differs from one load to the next. The set of photos in every card is identical (checked by comparing each card's image list); the order here is fixed. Everything outside the photos matches.
